use.zh-CN: 挂片加载的杠杆式向下拉动
use.en: Lever-based downward pulling loaded with weight plates

caution.zh-CN: 调整座位与大腿垫，核对空机阻力；握把轨迹和片重不能直接对照插片机
caution.en: Adjust seat and thigh pads; check unloaded resistance. Handle paths and plate loads are not directly equivalent to a weight-stack machine

evidenceScope.zh-CN: ACSM支持一般抗阻训练原则；厂商页面只核对本条目的结构，不证明效果或安全性。具体使用以型号手册为准。
evidenceScope.en: ACSM supports general resistance-training principles; the manufacturer page identifies structure only, without establishing efficacy or safety. Consult the model manual.
